content.summary: התנור הבריאותי Hamilton Beach 35052-IS מטגן וצולה באוויר חם ללא שימוש בשמן, בתא אפייה של 11 ליטר. יש לו הספק של 2000 W, טווח טמפרטורות של 30-200 מעלות צלזיוס וטיימר דיגיטלי של 60 דקות עם כיבוי אוטומטי. הוא מתאים למי שרוצה תוכניות אוטומטיות לצ׳יפס, עוף, דגים וסטייק במכשיר שעומד על השיש.

reviewFlags.issue: The catalog name and specs describe a 5 L black air-fryer pot at 1500 W and 80-200 °C. Two Israeli retailer pages for model 35052-IS describe an 11 L 'health oven' at 2000 W and 30-200 °C, 38 × 45 × 37 cm. The catalog name 'סיר לטיגון באוויר חם' contradicts the manufacturer-model description and must be checked.
Model 35052-IS appears on both retailer pages, but no manufacturer or importer page was found. The facts rest on two Israeli retailer pages (Electrica, Zabilo) that agree with each other.
The Israeli importer is not confirmed. Electrica says the warranty is 'שנה ע"י שאוליאן סחר', which may indicate the importer but is not stated as such.
The catalog says 8 built-in cooking programs. The retailer pages list about 7 program types and no count of 8, so the number is unverified.
The catalog says the timer has a voice alert. Retailer pages mention only a 60-minute digital timer with automatic shut-off, so the voice alert is unverified.
The catalog brand spelling 'Hemilton Beach' is a typo. Pages use 'Hamilton Beach'.

The catalog name and specs (air-fryer pot, 5 L, 1500 W, 80-200 °C) contradict both Israeli retailer pages for 35052-IS (11 L health oven, 2000 W, 30-200 °C). The catalog name and technical specifications need checking.
The catalog brand is spelled 'Hemilton Beach'. The sources use 'Hamilton Beach'.
The Israeli importer is unconfirmed. The warranty is listed as handled by שאוליאן סחר.
The catalog's 8 programs, voice alert, non-stick basket and dishwasher-safe claims could not be verified.

qa.notes: Both Israeli retailer pages name 35052-IS and agree on 2000 W, 30-200 °C, 11 L, 38×45×37 cm and a 60-minute timer. The catalog's 1500 W, 5 L and 80-200 °C figures are contradicted. Feature 4 (up to 25% cooking-time saving) was rejected as an unverifiable marketing claim. Zabilo was relabelled il-retailer (Israeli shop, exact model).
